questions.question: A furniture establishment initially disposes of a particular dining table for ₹Z, thereby realising a 25% profit margin. Subsequently, as a promotional strategy for a festive period, the marked price of this identical table is elevated to ₹1.6Z. Following this adjustment, a special concession of 20% is applied to the newly established marked price. The inquiry then seeks to ascertain the resulting percentage profit generated by the store during this specific celebratory sales period. What is the percentage profit earned by the store during the festive sale?
questions.questionHtml: A furniture establishment initially disposes of a particular dining table for ₹Z, thereby realising a 25% profit margin. Subsequently, as a promotional strategy for a festive period, the marked price of this identical table is elevated to ₹1.6Z. questions.question: A contractor employs 15 men to complete a work in 24 days, working 8 hours per day. After six days, he adds five more men but also reduces the working hours to six per day from the seventh day onwards. If all men work with the same efficiency throughout, how many more days will be required to finish the remaining work?
questions.questionHtml: A contractor employs 15 men to complete a work in 24 days, working 8 hours per day. After six days, he adds five more men but also reduces the working hours to six per day from the seventh day onwards. If all men work with the same efficiency throughout, how many more days will be required to finish the remaining work?
questions.solution:
<svg width="520" height="290" viewBox="0 0 520 290" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" style="display:block;margin:1px;background:#ffffff;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid #cccccc;box-sizing:border-box;">

    <marker id="arrO" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="6" markerHeight="6" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0,0 L10,5 L0,10 z" fill="#cc5500"/></marker>

  <!-- ZONE 1: WORK PROGRESS VISUALIZATION -->

  <rect x="40" y="80" width="100" height="40" fill="#f0f0f0" stroke="#555555" stroke-width="2"/>
  <rect x="140" y="80" width="300" height="40" fill="#ddeeff" stroke="#2255cc" stroke-width="2"/>

  <text x="60" y="152" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#555555">6 Days Done</text>
  
  <path d="M140,125 L140,135 L440,135 L440,125" fill="none" stroke="#2255cc" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <text x="230" y="152" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#2255cc">Remaining: ? Days</text>

questions.question: A thief and a police officer are 500 meters apart. If they run in the same direction, the police officer catches the thief in 10 minutes. If they run towards each other, they meet in 2 minutes. What is the speed of the thief in meters per minute?
questions.questionHtml: A thief and a police officer are 500 meters apart. If they run in the same direction, the police officer catches the thief in 10 minutes. If they run towards each other, they meet in 2 minutes. What is the speed of the thief in meters per minute?
questions.solution:
<svg width="550" height="285" viewBox="0 0 550 285" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" style="display:block;margin:1px;padding:0;background:#ffffff;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid #cccccc;box-sizing:border-box;">

  <text x="185" y="85" font-family="Arial" font-size="13" fill="#555555">Distance = 500 m (Time = 10 min)</text>

  <text x="200" y="115" font-family="Arial" font-size="12" fill="#555555" font-weight="700">OPPOSITE DIRECTION (Meeting)</text>
  <path d="M 40 150 L 480 150" stroke="#555555" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="8,4"/>

  <circle cx="60" cy="147" r="4" fill="#333"/>
  <circle cx="85" cy="147" r="4" fill="#333"/>
  <line x1="100" y1="137" x2="140" y2="137" stroke="#2255cc" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#arr)"/>

  <!-- Thief Car 2 -->
  <rect x="350" y="130" width="45" height="15" rx="3" fill="#fff0cc" stroke="#cc5500" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <circle cx="360" cy="147" r="4" fill="#333"/>
  <circle cx="385" cy="147" r="4" fill="#333"/>
  <line x1="345" y1="137" x2="305" y2="137" stroke="#cc5500" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#arrO)"/>

  <!-- Distance Gap 2 -->
  <path d="M 50 160 L 50 170 M 350 160 L 350 170 M 50 165 L 350 165" stroke="#555555" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="185" y="180" font-family="Arial" font-size="13" fill="#555555">Distance = 500 m (Time = 2 min)</text>

  <!-- ZONE 2: Solution lines -->
  <text x="30" y="210" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#222222">⇒ Relative speed (v<tspan baseline-shift="sub" font-size="9">p</tspan> − v<tspan baseline-shift="sub" font-size="9">t</tspan>) = 500 ÷ 10 = 50 m/min</text>
  <text x="30" y="235" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#222222">⇒ Relative speed (v<tspan baseline-shift="sub" font-size="9">p</tspan> + v<tspan baseline-shift="sub" font-size="9">t</tspan>) = 500 ÷ 2 = 250 m/min</text>
  <text x="30" y="260" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#222222">⇒ Thief speed (v<tspan baseline-shift="sub" font-size="9">t</tspan>) = (250 − 50) ÷ 2</text>

  <text x="30" y="280" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">∴ Answer = 100 meters/minute</text>
</svg>

questions.question: What type of number is the result of multiplying a Rational Number with an Irrational Number?
questions.questionHtml: What type of number is the result of multiplying a Rational Number with an Irrational Number?
questions.solution:
Rational number = 2 and irrational number = √3

⇒ 2 × √3 = 2√3 (Irrational)

Let rational number = 0 and irrational number = √3

⇒ 0 × √3 = 0 (Rational)

questions.question: Three metallic spheres with radii 3 cm, 4 cm, and 5 cm respectively are melted together and recast into a single solid sphere. What is the radius of the new sphere?
questions.questionHtml: Three metallic spheres with radii 3 cm, 4 cm, and 5 cm respectively are melted together and recast into a single solid sphere. What is the radius of the new sphere?
questions.solution:
Total volume = (4 ÷ 3)π(33 + 43 + 53)

Total volume = (4 ÷ 3)π(27 + 64 + 125) = (4 ÷ 3)π(216)

Let radius of new sphere = R ⇒ (4 ÷ 3)πR3 = (4 ÷ 3)π(216) ⇒ R3 = 216 ⇒ R = 6

questions.question: A car runs 18.4 km using 2 ½ liters of petrol. What is the mileage in km per liter (rounded to 2 decimals)?
questions.questionHtml: A car runs 18.4 km using 2 ½ liters of petrol. What is the mileage in km per liter (rounded to 2 decimals)?
questions.solution:
Distance covered = 18.4 km, Petrol used = 2 ½ liters = 2.5 liters

Mileage = Distance ÷ Petrol used

⇒ Mileage = 18.4 ÷ 2.5 = 7.36 km per liter

questions.question: In a three-way joint venture, the first investor contributes capital, the second contributes time and strategy, and the third brings a network of suppliers. They agree to share profits in the ratio 3:2:2. If the venture earns Rs. 1,40,000 in the first year, how much should the strategist (second partner) receive?
questions.questionHtml: In a three-way joint venture, the first investor contributes capital, the second contributes time and strategy, and the third brings a network of suppliers. They agree to share profits in the ratio 3:2:2. If the venture earns Rs. 1,40,000 in the first year, how much should the strategist (second partner) receive?
questions.solution:
Total ratio = 3 + 2 + 2 = 7

Share of second partner = (2 ÷ 7) × 1,40,000

Share of second partner = 40,000

questions.question: A ribbon is cut into three pieces in the ratio 2:3:5. If the length of the longest piece is 20 cm, what is the total length of the ribbon?
questions.questionHtml: A ribbon is cut into three pieces in the ratio 2:3:5. If the length of the longest piece is 20 cm, what is the total length of the ribbon?
questions.solution:
⇒ Total ratio = 2 + 3 + 5 = 10

⇒ 20 = (5 ÷ 10) × Total length

⇒ Total length = 20 ÷ (5 ÷ 10) = 20 × (10 ÷ 5) = 40 cm

questions.question: The average of a group of 8 consecutive even numbers is 41. What is the sum of the smallest and largest numbers in the group?
questions.questionHtml: The average of a group of 8 consecutive even numbers is 41. What is the sum of the smallest and largest numbers in the group?
questions.solution:
Average = 41, Number of terms = 8

Sum = 41 × 8 ⇒ 328

Let the numbers be a, a+2, ..., a+14

8a + 56 = 328 ⇒ 8a = 328 − 56 ⇒ a = 272 ÷ 8 ⇒ a = 34

Smallest number = 34, Largest number = 34 + 14 = 48

Required sum = 34 + 48 = 82

questions.question: A bucket has 60 litres of a solution with sugar and water in the ratio 5:1. If 12 litres of the solution are replaced with water, what is the new ratio?
questions.questionHtml: A bucket has 60 litres of a solution with sugar and water in the ratio 5:1. If 12 litres of the solution are replaced with water, what is the new ratio?
questions.solution:
⇒ Total parts = 5 + 1 = 6

⇒ Sugar = 60 × (5 ÷ 6) = 50 litres

⇒ Water = 60 × (1 ÷ 6) = 10 litres

⇒ Sugar removed = 12 × (50 ÷ 60) = 10 litres

⇒ Water removed = 12 × (10 ÷ 60) = 2 litres

⇒ Sugar left = 50 − 10 = 40 litres

⇒ Water left = 10 − 2 + 12 = 20 litres

⇒ New ratio = 40 : 20 = 2 : 1

questions.question: If cotA = \(\frac{7}{24}\) , then what is cosecA?
questions.questionHtml: If cotA = \(\frac{7}{24}\), then what is cosecA?
questions.solution:
cotA = 7 ÷ 24 ⇒ adjacent = 7, opposite = 24

hypotenuse2 = 72 + 242 ⇒ hypotenuse2 = 49 + 576 ⇒ hypotenuse = √625 = 25

cosecA = hypotenuse ÷ opposite ⇒ cosecA = 25 ÷ 24

questions.solution:
Radius = 5 cm, Chord length = 8 cm

Half chord = 8 ÷ 2 ⇒ 4 cm

52 = d2 + 42 ⇒ 25 = d2 + 16

questions.question: A circle of radius of 12 cm. Two radii are drawn such that the length of the chord connecting their endpoints is 12 cm. What is the area of the minor segment formed?
questions.questionHtml: A circle of radius of 12 cm. Two radii are drawn such that the length of the chord connecting their endpoints is 12 cm. What is the area of the minor segment formed?
questions.solution:
Radius = 12 cm, Chord length = 12 cm

⇒ 12 = 2 × 12 × sin(θ ÷ 2)

⇒ sin(θ ÷ 2) = 1 ÷ 2, θ ÷ 2 = 30º, θ = 60º

⇒ Area of sector = (60 ÷ 360) × π × 122 = 24π

⇒ Area of triangle = (1 ÷ 2) × 12 × 12 × sin60º = 36√3

⇒ Area of minor segment = 24π − 36√3

questions.question: If sin x = 0.6 and x ∈ (0, π/2), find sin 2x + cos 2x.
questions.questionHtml: If sin x = 0.6 and x ∈ (0, π/2), find sin 2x + cos 2x.
questions.solution:
cos x = √(1 − sin2x) ⇒ cos x = √(1 − 0.62) ⇒ cos x = √(0.64) ⇒ cos x = 0.8

sin 2x = 2 × sin x × cos x ⇒ sin 2x = 2 × 0.6 × 0.8 ⇒ sin 2x = 0.96

cos 2x = 1 − 2 × sin2x ⇒ cos 2x = 1 − 2 × 0.36 ⇒ cos 2x = 0.28

sin 2x + cos 2x = 0.96 + 0.28 ⇒ sin 2x + cos 2x = 1.24
